answer: In 2023–24, the survey went to 2,208 LEAs and recorded 1,579 responses, stated as about 72%. After excluding 385 LEAs that said they did not offer TK, the report also presents 1,579 responses among 1,823 remaining LEAs, stated as 87%. In 2024–25, the survey went to 1,464 LEAs and recorded 952 responses, stated as about 65%; it additionally says that 926 of the remaining LEAs (95%) indicated they had at least one TK program. Thus, year over year, 744 fewer LEAs were surveyed, 627 fewer responses were recorded, and the headline stated response rate fell 7 percentage points, from about 72% to about 65%.
